lines: Jayshree Harit Shah, Other Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling 70,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹2.31 crore are expected on or about Tuesday, November 3, 2026, per the offer document's timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Pre-offer capital shares are locked for 6 months from allotment, so retained holdings may mean more money later.
Gain and retained holding are unknown: average cost of acquisition and pre-offer holding are not confirmed from the documents.
